solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 2 i.e. Tribute.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• "Eulogy" means a speech or writing praising someone highly, often the deceased. Its closest synonym among the options is "tribute". (प्रशंसा)

◦ Example: The chief minister delivered a moving eulogy (tribute) at the funeral, praising the late leader's decades of selfless public service.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 2.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1 "Avoid" means to prevent or ward off an undesirable occurrence — different in sense from "eulogy".

• Option 3 "Fragile" means hard but liable to break or snap easily — different in sense from "eulogy".

• Option 4 "Cheerful" means cheerful, lively, and optimistic in mood — different in sense from "eulogy".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of eulogy: tribute. Antonyms: criticism.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 1.

 

Additional Information

• Option 3 "Deception" means trickery or deceit used to achieve one's ends — different in sense from "boisterous".

• Option 4 "Accomplish" means carry out or put a plan or task into effect — different in sense from "boisterous".

 

NOTE

• Synonym of boisterous: noisy. Antonyms: quiet, calm, subdued.
